Subject: Retaillytics pilot: evaluation rubric, 3-week sprint plan & owners

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we can get the 3-week pilot running next week. Short and actionable.

Call highlights
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Retaillytics’ near-real-time categorization pipeline (reduce human tagging by >= 60% on prioritized SKU types).
- Primary KPI: precision@top1 >= 88% on the pilot SKU subset; latency median < 120ms for 1–4 token responses in your staging environment.
- Success criteria (agreed):
  * Data: 5k representative SKUs, with descriptions + historical tags (label column)
  * Ops: API integration with staging (API key + allowlist CIDR)
  * Reporting: weekly quality snapshot + token-cost estimate

Proposed 3-week sprint (suggested owners)
Week 0 (prep, target completion in 3 business days) — Evelyn: finalize eval rubric and kickoff agenda; Alex/Priya: share sample data & staging IPs.
Week 1 (integration + smoke) — Mina: onboarding + schema validation; Retaillytics: integration test; produce first 500 predictions.
Week 2 (tuning + sampling) — Ben: model/config recommendations & cost tradeoffs; Redwood + Retaillytics: run targeted sampling and measure precision.
Week 3 (readout + next-steps) — Cross-team readout; decision: expand, refine prompts, or close trial.

Immediate asks (for kickoff)
1) Share a CSV export of 5k sample SKUs (data_schema_sample.csv stub in attachments) — Alex/Priya
2) Provide staging endpoint IP allowlist and preferred API key rotation window — Alex
3) Confirm who should be on the weekly 30-min check (suggested: Alex, Priya, Mina, Ben, Evelyn) — Alex
4) Sign MOA draft if legal team is ready (we'll circulate a DocuSign link) — Alex/Priya

Attachments included in this message: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (checklist) and data_schema_sample.csv (sample schema).

If that aligns, I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff and Mina will open the onboarding ticket. Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Evelyn

Hi Alex / Priya — jumping in with the onboarding checklist and a short cURL example to help your infra team. Attaching the checklist (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf) and a sample schema (data_schema_sample.csv).

Onboarding highlights
- Required: staging API key (can be rotated after week 1), allowlist the following domains: api.redwoodinference.com; if you need IP-level allowlist we'll provide ranges after you confirm the region.
- Data: CSV required columns = sku_id, title, description, historical_tag. Max file size for initial ingest: 50MB.
- Timing: typical onboarding + validation = 1–2 business days after we receive data and allowlist.

Sample cURL (for infra):
curl -X POST "https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/predict" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TRIAL_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"retail-ner-v1","inputs":[{"sku_id":"12345","text":"Small cotton t-shirt, blue"}]}'

I will open a dedicated onboarding ticket and ping your infra lead. I'll also upload a short checklist doc to the HubSpot company record.

Regards,
